title: This is the WORST Monitor Ever...ON PURPOSE! - Dasung PaperlikeU E-Ink Monitor
summary: Linus Tech Tips reviews the Dasung Paperlike E-Ink monitor, asking whether an e-paper display makes sense as a computer monitor. The video covers its slow refresh rate, eye-comfort claims and day-to-day usability.
why: HN commenters cite it as a realistic demonstration of E-Ink monitor refresh rates and how such displays feel in use.

quote.text: I do think the videos do a a good job of showing how the monitors feel.
